name: What are the primary benefits of building an attached ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the primary benefits of building an attached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an attached ADU offers several benefits for homeowners. It can significantly increase property value by adding livable space. For those seeking rental income, an attached ADU provides a steady revenue stream. It also offers flexible living arrangements, ideal for multi-generational families, aging parents, or adult children. Compared to detached units, attached ADUs can sometimes be more cost-effective due to shared infrastructure and a smaller footprint, potentially reducing utility and construction costs. They also allow for closer proximity to family members while maintaining independence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include increased property value, potential rental income, flexible living for families, and often lower construction costs than detached units.
